preconditions.description: The Prophesy must be a non-empty string with a length not exceeding 105 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() or c == '-' for c in prophesy)
preconditions.description: The Prophesy must only consist of digits and the character '-'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the date of the Apocalypse in the format 'dd-mm-yyyy'.

postconditions.expression: 2013 <= year <= 2015 and 1 <= month <= 12 and 1 <= day <= days_in_month(month, year)
postconditions.description: The output date must be a valid date within the specified year range and month/day constraints.

postconditions.expression: count_date(prophesy, day, month, year) > count_date(prophesy, other_day, other_month, other_year)
postconditions.description: The output date must occur more frequently in the Prophesy than any other valid date.
